# Diagnostic codes: pdk area

Codes `PDK-<TOPIC>-<NNN>` emitted by `src/core/src/pdk/` (owner: PDK,
`openspec/changes/m1-core-viewer/design.md` D2/D3). Conventions and the
renderings are described in [../codes.md](../codes.md).

The table below is generated from `src/core/src/pdk/codes.cpp`:

```sh
hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=pdk
```

The unit test `each area's code table matches its document and prefix`
fails when the two disagree.

<!-- BEGIN DIAGNOSTIC CODES (generated by `hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=pdk`) -->
| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `PDK-ENABLE-001` | error | A PDK variant path under the PDK root exists and is not a symbolic link; enabling changed nothing. |
| `PDK-FETCH-001` | error | A catalog document or PDK asset could not be downloaded. |
| `PDK-FETCH-002` | error | The catalog or release source has no such document (HTTP 404). |
| `PDK-INFO-001` | info | Progress of a PDK manager operation (download, verification, unpacking, install). |
| `PDK-INSTALL-001` | error | The PDK install could not create, move or remove files; nothing partial was kept. |
| `PDK-INSTALL-002` | error | The requested PDK version is not in the catalog. |
| `PDK-INSTALL-003` | error | The version manifest has no asset for a requested part (common or a library). |
| `PDK-INSTALL-004` | error | The PDK version (or the pinned version) is not installed. |
| `PDK-LIBRARY-001` | error | The library is not available for the PDK variant; nothing was downloaded. |
| `PDK-LICENSE-001` | error | The upstream license of the PDK family has not been accepted; a headless install needs -accept-license. |
| `PDK-MANIFEST-001` | error | A catalog manifest or release document is malformed. |
| `PDK-PACK-001` | error | An offline PDK pack or its pack.json is malformed, or names an asset the pack does not contain; nothing was installed. |
| `PDK-PIN-001` | warning | A project is re-pinned to another PDK version; recorded DRC, extraction and sign-off results become stale. |
| `PDK-PROGRESS-001` | info | Machine-readable install progress (`pdk install -progress`, `pdk import -progress`): phase, part, bytes, total, asset. |
| `PDK-SELECT-001` | error | The selector is not a valid PDK family or variant. |
| `PDK-UNINSTALL-001` | error | The PDK version is pinned by a project in the recent-projects list; uninstalling it needs -force. |
| `PDK-UNPACK-001` | error | An archive entry is absolute, contains '..' or leaves the version directory; the install was aborted. |
| `PDK-UNPACK-002` | error | The unpacked size of an asset exceeds the configured limit; the install was aborted. |
| `PDK-UNPACK-003` | error | An asset is not a valid (Zstandard-compressed) tar archive; the install was aborted. |
| `PDK-UNPACK-004` | warning | An archive entry is a link, device or FIFO and was not created. |
| `PDK-VERIFY-001` | error | A downloaded asset does not match the catalog size or SHA-256; it was deleted. |
| `PDK-VERIFY-002` | error | The PDK source is unverified (no Hefesto catalog signature) or an asset has no known SHA-256; installing needs explicit acceptance (-accept-unverified). |
<!-- END DIAGNOSTIC CODES -->
